subject: Inventory & ownership for ISO / FedRAMP audit window
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@atlas-audit.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: lena@pioneerhealth.com
Date: 2027-09-05T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Upcoming audit window + inventory ask

Hi Grace —

Pioneer Health is lining up their vendor audit window for the week of Oct 18. Before we lock dates on our side, two quick asks from the audit team so we can scope effort and confirm the right reviewers: 

1) Can you provide a current inventory of in-scope assets (compute pools, S3 buckets, VPCs used for customer workloads) and the owners for each item? Ideally a simple CSV mapping asset -> owner -> liveness (prod/stage/dev).
2) Any existing control mapping (ISO 27001 controls / FedRAMP controls -> evidence pointers) you can share early would help us pre-check what auditors will request.

Also: are there any blackout dates in October we should avoid for interviews?

If easier, send a short email with owners and we can follow with targeted interview invites.

Thanks —
Samir Patel
Atlas Audit
samir@atlas-audit.com

[Attachment: audit_checklist_template.pdf (pdf)]

From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@atlas-audit.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwoodinference.com>, Olga Petrov <olga@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-09-05T09:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming audit window + inventory ask

Samir — thanks for the heads up. Quick answers and next steps from our side: 

- We can produce an asset inventory CSV and a preliminary control-mapping doc. I’ll coordinate owners internally to make sure each item has a point of contact.
- Blackout dates: leadership offsite Oct 20-21; avoid those for executive interviews. Otherwise the week of Oct 18 looks workable.

Action plan: Karthik will own the inventory export and owner assignment, Mina will shepherd the ISO/FedRAMP control mapping, and Olga will coordinate evidence access and environment read-only snapshots for auditors. I’ll circulate the initial files by EOD Monday (Sep 6).

Questions for you to help scope: 
1) Are you expecting auditor access to any production consoles, or will screenshots/signed evidence suffice for the first pass?
2) Any specific FedRAMP baselining (Low/Moderate) we should assume for Pioneer Health?

Samir — if you can confirm the above two items (access level and baseline), we’ll tailor our exports and avoid over-sharing before the window.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference
grace@redwoodinference.com

[Attachment: none]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwoodinference.com>, Olga Petrov <olga@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@atlas-audit.com>
Date: 2027-09-05T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming audit window + inventory ask

Thanks Grace — quick update from infra: I ran an export of our asset registry and attached a first-pass CSV (inventory_v1.xlsx). It has columns: asset_id, asset_type, environment, owner, last_seen. I made some conservative owner assignments where the primary owner is ambiguous and added a comment column.

Notes / unknowns we should surface to the auditors:
- Several ephemeral dev clusters show up as "unowned" because they are provisioned by CI jobs; I can filter those out if we only need prod/stage.
- Logging buckets are common to multiple tenants; we can provide per-tenant access logs rather than raw bucket access if Pioneer requires separation.

I also dropped a stub control-mapping (control-mapping-draft.md) that links ISO clauses to our internal policies. Mina, can you add any existing evidence pointers (runbooks, SOC attestation references) into that doc and push to the Drive folder?

Samir: For access, my preference is to start with artifacts/screenshots and only provide readonly console sessions for narrow interview scopes. That keeps blast radius small.

Attachments: inventory_v1.xlsx, control-mapping-draft.md

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
karthik@redwoodinference.com

From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwoodinference.com>, Olga Petrov <olga@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@atlas-audit.com>
Date: 2027-09-06T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming audit window + inventory ask

Karthik / team — I reviewed the CSV and started filling the control mapping. A couple of items I want to flag so we can give a concise set of artifacts to the auditors: 

1) Evidence windows: auditors typically ask for 90 days of operational evidence for a FedRAMP Low assessment and 12 months for ISO 27001 scope items. Can you confirm which controls Pioneer expects us to demonstrate 12 months for vs 90 days? If Pioneer's baseline is Moderate, we should expect longer retention requests.

2) Owner confirmations: I’ll send a short BLAST to the listed owners asking them to confirm ownership and point to runbooks/evidence by Sep 13. Can we carve out 30–60m per owner for a short call the week of Sep 20 if needed?

3) Sensitive evidence handling: Olga, can you prepare an evidence access plan (S3 signed URL expiry, redaction guidance, logging) we can share with Samir so auditors know how to request materials?

Samir: if you can reply with the baseline (Low/Moderate) and whether Pioneer wants console read-only sessions in-scope, we’ll finalize the output. I linked the Drive folder here and will push updated artifacts as I edit them: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-inventory

Thanks —
Mina Haddad
Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
mina@redwoodinference.com

[Attachment: none]

From: Samir Patel <samir@atlas-audit.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-09-06T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming audit window + inventory ask

Mina / team — thanks for the quick follow-up and for the CSV. Pioneer Health confirms Low baseline for this engagement; 90 days is the primary evidence window for most technical controls, though they will request 12 months for select management-review artifacts and some vendor-attestation material.

We are fine to start with artifacts/screenshots. If auditors need console read-only, they will request it narrowly (and we can schedule bounded sessions).

Blackout noted for Oct 20-21. Please proceed with owner confirmations and send the Drive link to me when updated.

Samir Patel
Atlas Audit
samir@atlas-audit.com
